## What I work on

<table>
<tr>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

### 🏭 Energy and the environment

Long-run greenhouse gas emissions of economic activities in developing, resource-rich economies, with Chile as the main case: energy transitions and the environmental footprint of growth from the 1840s to today.

<code>GHG emissions</code> <code>Mining</code> <code>Energy transitions</code> <code>Decomposition analysis</code>

</td>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

### 👥 Living standards and well-being

How height, diet, health and living conditions changed with modernisation, and how unevenly across regions, with evidence from Chile.

<code>Anthropometrics</code> <code>Nutrition</code> <code>Sanitation and mortality</code> <code>Regional inequality</code>

</td>
</tr>
</table>

## Now

- 🎓 **PhD thesis** at the Public University of Navarre (supervised by Cristián Ducoing Ruiz and Mar Rubio-Varas): *Economic modernisation and its impact on sustainable development: the case of Chile*
